SIP precondition test starts from explicitly constructed early dialogs, then executes real h, qa1, cb4.k and C. Initial f82 creation and Gm encryption are covered on host, not in this ART fixture.

CTExcel policy tests directly invoke the installed helper on actual native config, registered-session, coroutine, Gm security model and SIP message objects. They do not execute f82.q or a real registration/security exchange; hook integration is independently checked by host and DEX verification.

New SMS repair tests exercise actual Runtime snapshots/saves/preparation and native gl5 objects with synthetic active phase and invalid legacy records. They do not execute a Compose button callback, native SMS sender, PDU codec or live IMS session.
Native TCP stacks are empty and have no output callback. Intended SIP packets are inspected before native closed-session discard; no operator, radio, audio or call quality validation is claimed.
The original SIP and dual-chip fixtures are rerun byte-for-byte; dual-chip transport remains synthetic.

New ART checks only load RCS adapter/binding classes, verify the API30 unavailable guard and exercise pure optional-trunk dialing helpers. The API33 real subscription service, RCS UI/provider binding, remote registration and messaging are not exercised; no RCS service availability is claimed.
